name: Shizuku
message: 「It’s over……」
I finished the match and returned to the contestants' waiting room.
For a while—without doing anything, I just stared at the wall.
I felt like a hollow hole had opened up in my chest.

name: Shizuku
message: 「……Am I frustrated？」
I couldn't make sense of my own feelings.
It was the first time I had ever thought about not wanting to lose to someone, and it was also the first time I had fought with such intense emotions.

name: Shizuku
message: 「I suppose this just wasn't for me……」
I wasn't good with intense emotions.
A moderate amount of happiness is fine. I want to go to a world where I don't have to be angry or sad.
To someone like me, this match felt completely out of place.
Without having my emotions in order, I challenged Suzakuin-san to a fight, and then suffered a pathetic defeat.

name: Shizuku
message: 「As I thought, being a fencer isn't for me……」
It was comical and hollow.

name: Shizuku
message: 「……Maybe I should just quit.」
The only reason I came to the academy was to gain an environment where I could stand on my own.
With my current track record, I should be able to get into a lab related to Tenju, or I could find a job and support myself.
As I was thinking that—

name: Victoria
message: 「……Shizu.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky……」
Vicky arrived. She had a somewhat guilty look on her face.

name: Victoria
message: 「You know, Shizu…… are you mad at me？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I’m not mad, but…… what’s wrong？」

name: Victoria
message: 「I’m sorry！ Shizu！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I hurt you without even realizing it！ I didn't mean to at all！」
As she said that, Vicky drew closer.

name: Victoria
message: 「I don't think you're unnecessary, Shizu！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I did think independent self-reliance was kind of cool, sure！ But I could never do it myself！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I need you, Shizu！ Shizu~！」
Saying that, Vicky clung to me.

name: Shizuku
message: 「S-stop it, Vicky……！」

name: Victoria
message: 「And you didn't act as my second in the first match because you started to hate me, right？ Isn't that it？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Come on, forgive me~, I love you so much, Shizu!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I-I don't know what to say even if you tell me that……！」

name: Victoria
message: 「What can I do to make you forgive me？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Anyway, let go for a second, it's suffocating.」
Vicky loosened her grip just a little. But she wouldn't let go of my hands.

name: Shizuku
message: 「First of all, I’m not angry at you, Vicky.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Then why wouldn't you be my Second？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Th-that’s because…… I wasn’t feeling well.」

name: Victoria
message: 「No！ I asked Sasaki. Shizu, you never went to the medical office！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ugh……」
It seems my feigned illness had been exposed.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, that’s not the real reason, is it？ I know. It's because I said something stupid.」

name: Victoria
message: 「……Winning the Martial Festival last year was all thanks to you, Shizu.」

name: Victoria
message: 「You customized my Origami, and you acted as my Second.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ever since then, I’ve relied on you so much.」

name: Victoria
message: 「I just assumed that you’d always understand me without me having to say anything, and that you’d always be by my side……」

name: Victoria
message: 「But…… that couldn't be true, could it? I was just taking advantage of your kindness, Shizu.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky……」

name: Victoria
message: 「And then I said something like, 'I'll just make my own Origami,' as if I had no idea how much work you put into it.」

name: Victoria
message: 「I realized that, and I’m reflecting on it.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Please, Shizu, don’t abandon me……！」
Vicky stares up at me with imploring eyes.
Thanks to her, I was forced to realize just how foolish my thoughts had been.

name: Shizuku
message: 「……No, I’m the one who should be apologizing, Vicky.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Everything that happened this time was just me misunderstanding your feelings and jumping to conclusions.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「You didn't do anything wrong, Vicky……」
That's right. Simply put, I was just jealous of the Suzakuin. That was all it really was.

name: Victoria
message: 「No, that’s not it. It’s my fault!」

name: Victoria
message: 「Shiz, you’re too kind！ You need to scold me properly！」

name: Victoria
message: 「If you don’t tell me, I won’t know！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「You’re right, Vicky…」
Even though I knew the kind of person Vicky was, I hadn’t been able to hide the suspicion inside me.

name: Shizuku
message: 「…I’m the same. If you don’t tell me, I get anxious.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「That you need me…」

name: Victoria
message: 「I see… Yeah, you’re right. Okay！」
Vicky’s face lit up instantly.

name: Victoria
message: 「Then I’ll tell you! I’ll say it as many times as it takes! Every single day!」

name: Victoria
message: 「Shiz, I need you!」

name: Victoria
message: 「If it weren't for you, Shiz, I never would have become a Toujinegi.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Thank you, Shiz！ I’m so grateful to you, Shiz！」

name: Victoria
message: 「So, I want you to stay by my side, forever and ever！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Shiz！ You are my ‘Other half’！」
‘Other half’—that is, the other half of one’s self, one’s soulmate.

name: Shizuku
message: 「…Thank you, Vicky.」
I was so happy that Vicky felt strongly enough to plead with me like that.
A single tear fell from Shizuku’s eye.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, I want to be by your side, too. I want to keep supporting you…！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Will you… accept me？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ Yes, yes, yes！」
Vicky hugged me again and whispered in my ear.

name: Victoria
message: 「I love you, Shiz… Lovin’ you…！」
At that incredibly passionate confession—
I couldn’t say anything back, and simply squeezed the Vicky in front of me in a tight embrace.
